description.value: Continuum Coffee Roasters is a specialty small-batch coffee roaster founded in 2012, now operating out of a roastery in Burnaby where visitors are welcome to stop in. They source fair trade, organic, and single-origin coffees from producers around the world, roasting in batches of 1–10 kg for maximum freshness. Cyclists passing through can explore a range of espresso blends, single-origin offerings, and limited special-release lots from notable producers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Continuum Coffee Roasters is an active specialty coffee roaster with a physical roastery in Burnaby, BC, that welcomes visitors (contact page: 'If you're interested in visiting us at the roastery'). No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the website; the OSM internet_access=wlan tag is not confirmed by website text so Wi-Fi is marked null per rules. The OSM community field says 'Vancouver' but the About Us page explicitly states the roastery is in Burnaby — flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM community field is 'Vancouver' but the About Us page explicitly states the roastery is located in Burnaby — the address should be listed as Burnaby, BC.
No phone number present in OSM tags or on the website.
Walk-in retail/cafe service is not explicitly confirmed; the roastery primarily operates as an online retailer and wholesaler, though the contact page invites in-person visits.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active specialty coffee roaster with a publicly accessible roastery location that explicitly welcomes visitors; confirmed open as of OSM check_date 2026-04-04.
